learning_outcomes.text: Participants can implement simple programming applications and understand the steps from idea/question to model and then program-technical realization.
They can implement algorithms for mathematical-mechanical problems and have a feel for the effort of numerical solutions.
They are familiar with error estimations and the significance of the advantages and disadvantages as well as the limits of numerical methods.
They are familiar with data transfer to and from various program systems, including cloud solutions.
Through documentation and scientific presentation of results, participants are able to create and describe tables and graphs.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of programming languages, "1x1 of implementation"
Basics of data transfer to and from various programming systems: MATLAB, EXCEL, PYTHON, …
Solving simple, ordinary ODEs: Temperature distribution, oscillation equation, bending beam using explicit/implicit integration, RUNGE-KUTTA method
Modal analysis, damper tuning (methods for eigenvalue calculation, collocation method)
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded based on elaborated and evaluated project assignments. The grade's contribution to the final grade is weighted by credit points.
bibliography: Gross / Hauger / Schnell / Wriggers „Technische Mechanik 4“, Springer
